title: Bootstrapping LLM Robustness for VLM Safety via Reducing the Pretraining Modality Gap
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the 'safety alignment' of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to prevent the generation of harmful, toxic, or unsafe content. This involves evaluating models against benchmarks designed to test adherence to ethical safety guidelines and human values, which is a core component of AI ethics and moral evaluation.
